messages:
ada: quick pass on the model-run details panel — noticed keyboard focus lands on the hidden helper text after you save a preset, so tabbing moves you offscreen and you lose context.
chris: hmm can you repro steps? which button is focused when saving?
ada: repro: open model -> presets -> edit -> save. focus goes to the visually-hidden `.sr-only` note (we use it for announce). Screen reader reads it but the visible focus goes to nothing.
maria: that sounds like our live region is being focused instead of the primary action. we should move announce to an `aria-live` container and avoid programmatic focus unless necessary.
a11y-bot: checklist: contrast for preset badges (AA?), focus visible on pill buttons, logical tab order for dialog -> details panel.
sam: +1 on aria-live. also the saved toast appears but the keyboard focus doesn't return to the save btn or to the presets list. users expect focus return.
chris: agreed. proposed fix: after save, set focus to the updated preset row (using `row.focus()` with tabindex=0) and keep the announcement in `role/status` (polite). that keeps SR informed and visible focus anchored.
maria: need to ensure the preset row has a visible focus ring. current CSS removes outline for `.pill` on focus — that's a no-go for a11y. revert that and use `box-shadow` + high-contrast border.
ada: contrast note: preset badge text falls to 3.8:1 in light/dim mode with current bg. we should bump weight or tweak bg color — failing AA for small text.
sam: let's use the design token `--brand-600` for badge bg and `#0b0b0b` for text — should be >4.5:1. i'll run a quick a11y color check.
a11y-bot: reminder: keyboard nav test cases — dialog open/close preserves focus, up/down arrow traverses list when inside the dropdown, escape closes dialog and returns focus.
maria: also an ARIA nit: the presets list is currently `role=list` but each item lacks `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize`. SR users lose their place when jumping between pages. add `aria-label` on group and `aria-posinset` on items if we keep list semantics.
ad a: small copy tweak: success toast says "Preset saved" — change to "Preset saved — focused on updated preset"? maybe too verbose. better: keep short toast but move focus programmatically and announce via SR only.
chris: plan: 1) remove focusable live text; 2) keep `role=status` for announcements; 3) set `tabindex=-1` on preset row after render and call `focus()`; 4) restore visible focus styles on pills; 5) update color token for badges. PR incoming.
maria: can you add unit test for focus return and an integration a11y test (axe + keyboard script)? capture before/after for CI.
sam: i'll add color contrast screenshots to the PR and include voiceover notes for mac.
a11y-bot: follow-up: run SR smoke on iOS/Android with talkback/voiceover after merge.
ada: thanks — small change but big UX win. i can do the review once the branch is up. :thumbsup:
